name: batch-1-metal-core
note: REA_18 §5 batch 1, the Metal core: the five ELEMENT_PAIR cells a Metal core reads (金_木 the Action, 金_火 the Order, 金_土 the Mind, 金_金 the Body, 金_水 the Expression) with both poles, both turns, both definitions, both advices, the verdict, the base and the carry parts for every state the cell renders (the station's carry keys; 金_金 has no wide, missing or spared and carries unrooted), and the ten ELEMENT_GOD cells whose god sits on a Metal core (the ELEMENT_GOD key is <energy>_<god>: the Mind pair on Earth, 土_偏印 and 土_正印; the Action pair on Wood, 木_偏财 and 木_正财; the Body pair on Metal, 金_比肩 and 金_劫财; the Expression pair on Water, 水_食神 and 水_伤官; the Order pair on Fire, 火_七杀 and 火_正官), both poles, all three rows, all three angles, candidates: 2 on each drive passage. Built by handoff.mjs --scope on prompt v0.7.1 (2026-10-14). The yin sibling's overrides (mechanism_yin, carry_yin, read by 辛) are not in this batch; the 辛 contrast of REA_18 §5 is read, not written, here. No chart: no percentage, no band, no state of one chart in any value.
